articles.summary: BRANFORD, Conn., May 01, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Sachem Capital Corp. (NYSE American: SACH) (the “Company”) announced today that the Company will release its first quarter 2026 financial results before market opens on Friday, May 15, 2026. A webcast and conference call to discuss the results will be held on Friday, May 15, 2026, at 8:00 a.m. Eastern Time. Webcast: A webcast of the conference call will be available on the Investors section of the Company’s website www.sachemcapitalcorp.com
articles.title: Sachem Capital Sets Date for First Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call
